GameConditionDef.label: post-transfer safe period
GameConditionDef.description: The ship has just completed a transfer flight and nobody here has noticed it yet. No events, including raids, will occur on this map until this ends. Smaller ships stay unnoticed for longer.\n\nEvents forced by quests are not prevented.
GameConditionDef.endMessage: The post-transfer safe period has ended. Events can occur on this map again.
